questions.question: Which trip length should be planned: the preferred 15–18 Feb 2027 (3 nights) or the 7-night window used for hotel totals?
questions.whatWeKnow: 15 Feb 2027 is a Monday and 18 Feb is a Thursday; 15–22 Feb 2027 is exactly 7 nights (calendar arithmetic).
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Which duration the traveler wants priced and booked.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Site uses 15–22 Feb 2027 as the 7-night planning case and keeps the 3-night preference visible.
questions.howToDiscover: Pick one window before requesting live quotes; all hotel totals depend on it.

questions.question: What is the real total price for a 7-night stay for two adults, including taxes and fees?
questions.whatWeKnow: Booking.com returned 15–22 Feb 2027 / 2-adult / 7-night pre-tax snapshots for 8 of the 10 qualifying hotels, captured 2026-11-25 or 2026-11-26. Rates include different room and cancellation plans; room/resort fees and excluded taxes are documented per row. No full final checkout total was captured.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: The final checkout total for the selected room on the day of payment, including all taxes, city/destination fees and any resort fee; the best direct-hotel rate; and whether the volatile OTA rate will remain available.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Treat each hotel figure only as a dated Booking.com pre-tax snapshot, not an official hotel quote or a verified all-in total. The Hotels table leaves the all-in field blank instead of modeling tax arithmetic.
questions.howToDiscover: Compare the exact named room and cancellation plan on the hotel's own booking engine and the OTA; proceed to the final checkout summary and record the full taxes/fees, date, room and screenshot before paying.

questions.question: Which shortlisted hotels actually have a private bathroom and a queen-size bed or larger for two adults on the chosen dates?
questions.whatWeKnow: Ten shortlisted properties now have a named Queen- or King-bed room and private bathroom verified from primary property-room pages: DoubleTree Chelsea, Hyatt Place Chelsea, Eurostars Wall Street, Arlo NoMad, The Frederick, The Evelyn, 11 Howard, citizenM Times Square, The Beekman and The Fifth Avenue Hotel.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Whether each exact room type is still available for the chosen dates at checkout; the rate-plan/bed assignment can differ from a property's general room catalogue. Six earlier MICHELIN candidates remain outside this qualifying shortlist pending room-level evidence.
questions.provisionalAnswer: All ten current shortlist entries meet the room-spec requirement at property-page level. Confirm exact dated availability and the selected room's bed/bath before payment; the two unpriced properties still have no dated rate.
questions.howToDiscover: Open the row's official room-page link and confirm the named Queen/King room plus private bath in the actual dated booking plan. Re-check both at final checkout.

questions.question: Which Michelin distinctions will be current during the February 2027 trip?
questions.whatWeKnow: As of 25 Nov 2026 the Michelin list shows 5 three-star, 14 two-star and 50 one-star NYC restaurants. The 2026 Northeast Cities ceremony is scheduled for 14 Dec 2026.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Awards that will be announced after this research date and before travel.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Use the live 25 Nov 2026 list and re-check after 14 Dec 2026.
questions.howToDiscover: Re-read the official Michelin star list immediately after the ceremony and update the data JSON.

questions.question: How many Michelin restaurants are within one hour by subway or bus of each hotel?
questions.whatWeKnow: The T11 dataset records 25 Google Maps transit-mode 'leave now' legs from five hotel origins to five representative MICHELIN clusters, captured 2026-11-25 17:14–17:31 ET; returned times range from 3 to 37 minutes. The origins include four hotels in the current shortlist and one separate reference hotel. Several very short results were walk-only, not subway/bus rides.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Future February 2027 service conditions or departure-time-specific journeys; exact transit-only results for every shortlisted hotel, all restaurant/attraction pairs, and any accessibility requirements.
questions.provisionalAnswer: The sampled Google Maps results are all under 60 minutes, but they are live snapshots and do not establish a future timetable or a complete public-transit-only matrix. Do not rank every hotel from this sample.
questions.howToDiscover: For the chosen hotel and itinerary, rerun Google Maps with transit constrained at the intended departure times, reject walk-only routes when the subway/bus rule is strict, and save the timestamp, duration and link.

questions.question: What will a couple actually pay at each Michelin restaurant?
questions.whatWeKnow: 19 restaurant rows now have an official menu/booking-channel price for two, captured 2026-11-25–26 (food/menu subtotal except where the source includes an administrative fee): EMP $770/$510; Le Bernardin $700/$450 dinner/$284 lunch (current PDF; earlier PDFs showed $436/$274); Jungsik $670; Masa $990/$1,500/$1,900; Gabriel Kreuther $650/$400/$470; The Modern $230/$510/$370/$570; Chef's Table at Brooklyn Fare $770; Aquavit $390; odo $300/$540; Cote $168/$450; Kochi $290; Mari $290; Jua $300; Gramercy Tavern $356/$156; Le Coucou $440; Sushi Sho $990 prepaid; Saga $430/$630/$730; Aska $750; Atomix $848/$628. Michelin's least-expensive-starred feature is indicative, not a venue quote.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Feb–Mar 2027 menu prices, taxes/tip/drinks and final booking charges; exact menu prices for Per Se (official pages show a deposit), Atera (source conflict), Sushi Noz, César, Joo Ok and many à-la-carte venues. Several amounts include administrative fees while others do not; follow each row's note.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Use only the linked per-person menu/booking snapshots as a planning reference, not a trip-date quote. Recheck the venue's official source at booking; never convert MICHELIN's price band into a bill.
questions.howToDiscover: Fetch each restaurant's official menu/pricing page shortly before booking and record a screenshot plus date.

questions.question: Are Broadway show titles and ticket prices available for the chosen dates?
questions.whatWeKnow: NYC Tourism's official update page lists several Broadway openings in spring 2027, after the proposed trip; TKTS publishes discount mechanics but no booth hours were verified.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: The February 2027 performance schedule, titles, prices and TKTS booth hours.
questions.provisionalAnswer: No show-specific rows are presented as verified.
questions.howToDiscover: Check each show's official site and TKTS official booth page when 2027 sales open.

questions.question: Which social-media accounts actually belong to each venue, and which posts are current?
questions.whatWeKnow: Official accounts confirmed from the venues' own pages: MoMA @themuseumofmodernart; The Met @metmuseum; AMNH @amnh; Empire State Building @empirestatebldg (incl. verified TikTok); Whitney @whitneymuseum; Guggenheim; 9/11 Memorial @911Memorial; High Line @highlinenyc; NYPL @nypl. Restaurants: Per Se (Tock), Aska (site footer), Eleven Madison Park and Le Bernardin (Resy venue pages). NYC Parks and NPS link their own accounts.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Official account ownership for the remaining restaurants/venues; whether linked third-party reviews still represent current menus/hours.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Third-party links are labelled as such. Blank where no link could be confirmed.
questions.howToDiscover: Follow 'social' links from each venue's official website footer and record handle/URL plus the page that confirms ownership.

questions.question: What is the total budget ceiling for two adults, and what share of it is accommodation?
questions.whatWeKnow: Eight of ten qualifying hotel candidates have 7-night Booking.com pre-tax snapshots for 15–22 Feb 2027, captured 25–26 Nov 2026. The snapshots span about $1,040 to $4,942 depending on property/room/rate plan, but final checkout totals and the budget ceiling are not known.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: The traveler's budget ceiling, the final all-in checkout amount for the selected room/rate plan, and whether a direct-hotel offer or another room is better value.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Show pre-tax aggregator snapshots and their rate terms without calling them all-in totals or assuming a budget. Compare actual checkout totals only after the traveler sets a ceiling and selects the room/cancellation plan.
questions.howToDiscover: Set the budget ceiling, then compare the exact room/rate plan at the hotel and aggregator checkout; record all taxes/fees and cancellation terms before deciding.

questions.question: Which airport, at what airfare, and does the arrival allow a 19:00 dinner on day one?
questions.whatWeKnow: Three airports serve the city (JFK, LGA, EWR). Atera's Monday service starts at 19:00.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Airfare, arrival airport, transfer time and cost. No flight research was done in either session.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Day one is left light: check-in plus an evening dinner that can flex. Nothing time-critical before 19:00.
questions.howToDiscover: Price flights for 15 Feb and 22 Feb 2027, then re-time day one.

questions.question: What are typical mid-February conditions, and which activities are weather-dependent?
questions.whatWeKnow: Several planned activities are outdoors (Brooklyn Bridge walk, Central Park, the High Line, Top of the Rock terraces).
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Typical temperature and precipitation for 15-22 Feb; no climate source was checked by either session.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Indoor anchors (museums, dining) are scheduled on fixed days; outdoor items stay movable.
questions.howToDiscover: Add a climate-normals reference (for example National Weather Service climate data) and tag each activity indoor/outdoor.

questions.question: Are there mobility, dietary or accessibility requirements that must filter the shortlist?
questions.whatWeKnow: MICHELIN publishes facilities per restaurant (wheelchair access, vegetarian/vegan/halal/kosher options); hotels list accessible room types.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Whether any requirement applies. One allergy or mobility need can eliminate half the starred list.
questions.provisionalAnswer: No filter applied; all rows carry their published facilities so a filter can be added without re-research.
questions.howToDiscover: State the requirement, then filter on the MICHELIN 'Services & Facilities' tags already in the records.
